exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: No weights are filled in. Start light, type what you lift on the first set, and the app remembers it from then on; when every set reaches 6 it will tell you to add weight. Bar on the upper back, big breath, sit down between the knees, drive the floor away.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Feet flat, shoulder blades pinched, bar to the lower chest, press to lockout.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.notes: Hinge to about 45 degrees, pull the bar to the lower ribs, lower under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Seated or standing. Elbows a little forward, press to lockout without leaning back.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Elbows under the shoulders, squeeze the glutes, one straight line. Too easy? Lift one foot.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: Bar over mid-foot, hips high enough to keep the back flat, push the floor away. Reset every rep.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Bar at the collarbones, squeeze the glutes, press straight up and move the head through at the top.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Chest up, pull to the collarbones, control the way back. Pull-ups instead once you can do 6 in a row.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lunge
exercises.notes: 8 to 12 each leg. Step far enough that the front shin stays vertical.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Cable or band at face height. Pull to the ears with the elbows high. This is what keeps the shoulders healthy under the presses.
